question: What is the common name for a saturated solution of calcium hydroxide widely used as a raw material in the chemical industry?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Slaked lime**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Slaked lime** is the common name for a **saturated solution of calcium hydroxide**.
 
• It is widely used as a raw material in the chemical industry for various applications.
 
• Calcium hydroxide, also known as **hydrated lime**, is produced by adding water to **quicklime **(calcium oxide).
 
• Slaked lime is used in the production of **mortar and plaster**, in water and sewage treatment, and in the paper industry.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Calcium hydroxide** has a chemical formula of **Ca(OH)₂**.
 
• It is a **colorless crystal or white powder**.
 
• Slaked lime is slightly soluble in water and forms a solution known as limewater, which is used to test for the presence of carbon dioxide.
 
• When carbon dioxide is passed through limewater, it turns milky due to the formation of calcium carbonate.
